content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a critical infrastructure problem: they cannot accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s through Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. These platforms either do not operate in their regions or impose severe restrictions. This leaves creators unable to sell their ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products effectively. The solution is not a workaround but a sovereign commerce stack—a self-owned, fully operational infrastructure that processes crypto payments, delivers products instantly, and ensures full data ownership. This post breaks down how to deploy such a stack using free and paid tools, with a focus on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-every-detail-you-need-2|Bitcoin Payments]]-payments-digital-downloads-what-actually-how-works-5|bitcoin]] and other cryptocurrencies.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

A sovereign commerce stack is a complete digital store infrastructure that you own and control. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% per sale, this stack uses NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. For a creator selling a $97 product, 100 sales per month would retain $921 more in revenue. The stack includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture eliminates platform dependencies, ensuring you retain full ownership and control over your business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates on a simple yet robust architecture. A buyer selects a product, pays in cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, USDT), and the payment is verified on-chain via NOWPayments. Once confirmed, a webhook triggers the backend logic—either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—to deliver the product instantly. Order details are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets for record-keeping. This process is automated, secure, and does not require manual intervention. The use of free hosting and storage tools keeps costs minimal, while the crypto payment gateway ensures global accessibility without KYC or buyer account requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or restrictive. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this infrastructure empowers you to operate independently. It is ideal for creators who value sovereignty over their business, want to avoid platform fees, and seek a reliable way to accept payments globally. By deploying this stack, you no longer rely on third-party platforms that can lock you out or impose arbitrary restrictions. Instead, you own the infrastructure and control every aspect of your sales process.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—95% less than Gumroad’s 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack’s components are carefully selected to ensure seamless integration and minimal cost. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating product delivery and order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files efficiently. NOWPayments acts as the crypto payment gateway, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. Each component is free or low-cost, and the entire stack is designed to be scalable, secure, and fully self-owned.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack today, start by choosing the right tools for your needs. For a quick start, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH, which come pre-configured and ready to deploy in 48 hours. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, allowing you to build and customize your stack from scratch. Follow the step-by-step guides provided, load your products, and test the entire workflow before going live. With this infrastructure, you’ll be ready to sell digital products globally, free from platform restrictions and fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. This stack eliminates platform fees and ensures you retain full control over your sales process. For example, replacing Gumroad’s 10% fee with NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee on a $97 product saves $9.20 per sale—or $920 at 100 sales per month. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates needed to build this infrastructure.
The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages and Google Sheets, minimizing costs.

If you’re looking to sell notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or want a digital download store that operates entirely on crypto, the principles outlined here apply directly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, offering everything you need to deploy and scale a sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase and start building today.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, reliable storefront hosting. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery and order processing. 3. Configure order storage: Opt for Supabase or Google Sheets to securely store transaction data. 4. Enable file delivery: Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver digital products instantly. 5. Integrate NOWPayments: Set up crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies. 6. Test the workflow: Ensure all components work seamlessly before launching your store. 7. Deploy and scale: Go live and expand your product offerings as your business grows.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are pre-configured and deployed in 48 hours, requiring no technical expertise. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes detailed blueprints for those who want to customize their stack.
Which cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transaction fees under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose the most cost-effective options for your buyers.
Do I need to pay recurring fees for this infrastructure?
No, the stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Google Sheets, and Cloudflare Workers. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% per transaction, with no subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this stack?
Yes, the stack supports ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Simply load your products and configure the delivery logic accordingly.
What happens if a payment fails or is disputed?
NOWPayments automatically verifies payments on-chain, reducing the risk of disputes. If a payment fails, the buyer can retry, and the system will only deliver the product once payment is confirmed.
You own the infrastructure—no platform dependencies, no subscriptions, lifetime access.
